scenes.title: A setup is not an entry
scenes.narration: A setup can look attractive and still be ineligible. Before any paper order, the evidence chain has to be complete.

scenes.title: Use completed bars
scenes.narration: Start with completed, timestamped bars. An unfinished candle can change the story before the session is over.

scenes.title: Check the source
scenes.narration: Confirm the data source, the market scope, and whether the instrument is actually tradable through the intended route.

scenes.title: Freshness and liquidity matter
scenes.narration: Missing history, stale quotes, wide spreads, or weak liquidity can make a chart look cleaner than the decision really is.

scenes.title: Intraday confirmation
scenes.narration: Even a high setup quality score still needs fresh quotes, a sensible relationship to VWAP, and the required completed intraday sequence.

scenes.title: No trade is valid
scenes.overlay: Stand down when evidence is incomplete
scenes.narration: If the evidence chain cannot be verified, standing down is the disciplined result. The process does not need a trade every day.
